Explain the system role of the Registry key "HKLM\\Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\RemovableStorageDevices\\Custom" in its complete prefix context.

Groups separate machine read and write policies for custom removable-storage classes.

This machine RemovableStorageDevices Custom namespace groups policies for removable-storage classes selected by an administrator rather than a predefined class branch. Its Deny_Read and Deny_Write children separate read restrictions from write restrictions. This grouping role is inferred from documented mappings to those children. The Custom parent is not itself a denial flag, a device identifier, or evidence of access to a physical drive.

Scope: machine. Evidence status: structural.
Applicability: The referenced ADMX CSP tables list device scope on Pro, Enterprise, Education, and IoT Enterprise: Windows 10 2004/20H2/21H1 with KB5005101, and Windows 11 21H2 or later. These are CSP delivery baselines; they do not date the introduction of the underlying Group Policy setting.
